title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Line up three X's in a row against the computer or a friend on the same screen in this quick, free Tic Tac Toe game for your browser.
about:
Tic Tac Toe is the timeless game of X's and O's, played on a big, bright 3×3 grid that fills your screen. Take turns placing your mark and be the first to get three in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally. When someone wins, a yellow line strikes through the winning row, and a full board with no line ends in a draw.

There are two ways to play. In 1 Player mode you are X and the computer answers with an O a moment after each of your moves, choosing a random free square, so it is a relaxed opponent that is great for kids and beginners. Pick 2 Players and you and a friend take turns on the same phone, tablet or computer. A scoreboard keeps track of wins and draws for each mode and is saved in your browser.

Every round lasts less than a minute, which makes it perfect for a quick break or a friendly rematch.
howToPlay: Players take turns placing X and O on the 3×3 grid, and X always goes first. The first player to get three marks in a row, column or diagonal wins. If all nine squares are filled with no line, the game is a draw. Press Play again or New game to start the next round, and choose 1 Player or 2 Players below the board.

controls.action: Play against the computer or a friend (starts a new round)
Clear the board and start a new round
Place a mark on the matching square (1 is top left)
Set the scoreboard of the current mode back to zero

tips: Take the center square on your first move: it is part of four possible lines.
Corners are the next best squares, since each one belongs to three lines.
Try to create two threats at once so your opponent can only block one of them.
Always check whether your opponent has two in a row before making your own move.

faq.question: Is Tic Tac Toe free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The board grows to fill your screen in portrait or landscape, and you simply tap a square to place your mark.

faq.question: Can two people play on the same device?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose 2 Players and take turns tapping the board; in 1 Player mode you play X against a computer that picks random free squares.
